facts.text: The hotel is on Syntagma Square in central Athens, overlooking the Hellenic Parliament and the National Garden.
facts.excerpt: Bang on Syntagma (Constitution) Square, overlooking the Hellenic Parliament and balmy National Garden

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Monastiraki flea market, museums and the business district.
facts.excerpt: This luxury property is within walking distance of Monastiraki flea market, museums, and the business district

facts.text: The hotel has stood in the heart of Athens since 1874.
facts.excerpt: Situated in the heart of the city since 1874, this landmark hotel in Athens, Greece, near the Acropolis

facts.text: When the Olympic Games were revived in 1896, the hotel was the official host of foreign missions, diplomats, statesmen and royalty.
facts.excerpt: When the Olympic Games were revived for the first time in 1896, the Hotel Grande Bretagne was the official host of foreign missions, diplomats, statesmen, political figures and royalty.

facts.text: In 1960 Maria Callas stayed at the hotel, and the piano she used for rehearsals is in the Royal Suite.
facts.excerpt: The piano used for her rehearsals remains an exquisite addition to the Royal Suite of the Hotel.

facts.text: Sir Winston Churchill was a frequent guest, and a meeting room in the hotel bears his name.
facts.excerpt: Sir Winston Churchill becomes a frequent guest of the Hotel, solidifying his connection to its legacy. As a tribute to his esteemed presence, a meeting room within the Hotel now bears his name.

facts.text: In-house guests can take a museum tour of the hotel's history, antiques and art masterpieces on request.
facts.excerpt: In-house guests are guided through the hotel’s history while being led through its rooms and introduced to its antiques and art masterpieces.

facts.text: Rooms and suites combine sumptuous fabrics, original artworks, museum-quality antiques and classic architectural features with modern technology.
facts.excerpt: Sumptuous fabrics, original artworks, museum-quality...See More antiques and classic architectural features combine with modern technology

facts.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows give views across Acropolis Hill and Syntagma Square.
facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows offer an abundance of natural light and captivating views across Acropolis Hill and Syntagma Square

facts.text: Suite guests receive personalized 24-hour Butler Service and expedited check-in.
facts.excerpt: Personalized 24-hour Butler Service and expedited check-in is offered to all 56 luxury suites at this Athens hotel.

facts.text: The fifth-floor Royal Suite has one bedroom and two bathrooms, with windows framing views of Syntagma Square, the Acropolis, the Parliament and Lycabettus Hill.
facts.excerpt: Located on the fifth floor of the Hotel Grande Bretagne, our sprawling one-bedroom, two-bathroom Royal Suite encompasses over 400 magnificent square meters, while its many windows frame iconic views of Athens

facts.text: Quieter rooms overlook the courtyard gardens.
facts.excerpt: the quieter rooms overlooking the courtyard gardens have a cozy charm of their own

facts.text: The GB Roof Garden rooftop restaurant serves Mediterranean dining with views of the Acropolis, Lycabettus Hill and Parliament.
facts.excerpt: With Acropolis, Lycabettus Hill and Parliament views, this luxury restaurant in Athens pairs Mediterranean dining with Wine Spectator recognition.

facts.text: The Winter Garden is known for its afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: Moreover, the Winter Garden is renowned for its afternoon high tea.

facts.text: An 18th-century tapestry of Alexander the Great is the focal point of Alexander's Bar.
facts.excerpt: The 18th century tapestry of Alexander the Great is the focal point of the Alexander’s Bar

facts.text: The outdoor pool is on the 7th floor with backdrops of Lycabettus Hill.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 7th floor, the 50 sq. meters outdoor pool provides a cool respite from Athens' summer sun. With picture-perfect backdrops of Lycabettus Hill

facts.text: The pool deck becomes an open-air movie theater in summer.
facts.excerpt: the pool deck is transformed into an open-air movie theater during the summer

facts.text: The GB Spa is temporarily closed for renovation; a selection of massages and facials is offered in adapted rooms on the first floor.
facts.excerpt: As the GB Spa undergoes an exciting renovation, a selection of spa services continues to be offered in specially adapted, tranquil spaces within repurposed guest rooms on the first floor of the hotel

facts.text: The GB Spa indoor pool is temporarily closed for renovation.
facts.excerpt: ### GB Spa Indoor Pool - Temporarily Closed for Renovation

facts.text: The Wine Library on the mezzanine of the GB Corner showcases the hotel's wine labels and hosts Greek wine masterclasses.
facts.excerpt: It would be a miss not to mention the Greek Wine Masterclasses, in which our guests can participate, taking place at The Wine Library.

facts.text: The concierge team are Clefs d'Or members who arrange tours, dinner reservations and tickets.
facts.excerpt: proudly wearing the “clef d’or”—the gilt insignia of the celebrated international concierge society—and eager to reveal the secret treasures of Athens and beyond

facts.text: Children are welcomed, with children's menus, high chairs and babysitting on request.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Grande Bretagne welcomes children and wishes to make their stay as pleasant and welcoming as possible.

facts.text: The downtown setting around the hotel has hectic energy and roaring traffic.
facts.excerpt: While the hectic energy and roaring traffic of downtown

facts.text: Classic rooms are pretty snug; suites are the best bet for families.
facts.excerpt: Suites are the best bet for families, as classic rooms are pretty snug.

facts.text: A smart dress code is strictly imposed for dinners at GB Roof Garden.
facts.excerpt: (with a smart dress code strictly imposed)

facts.text: The hotel underwent a major restoration in 2003.
facts.excerpt: In 2003, with an investment of 82 million euro, the Hotel Grande Bretagne underwent a massive restoration
